note: VS-4 HB-46 (04 §2.15, 02 §6.5; ВР-VS2-HB44-03): the fighter plate names on the UI language. Heroes and sidekicks are data (docs/game-design/05-content-matrix.csv: Medusa (Медуза), King Arthur (Король Артур), Merlin (Мерлин)); a numbered sidekick (the three Harpies) reads hud.plate.harpy_name «Гарпия {number}» / «Harpy {number}» with the sidekicks[] number of the Z-1 base digit. A hero without an entry shows the server label.
